Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Bowie for 2026, and here is what he found: 11 family events, 7 of them free. The magic runs from November 30 (Letters to Santa) through December 20 (the Magic Elf Hunt), with Marietta's Winter Holiday Celebration (December 3 to 11), the Holiday Tree Lighting Ceremony (December 5), the Candlelight Open House with Santa Claus (December 6) and Skate with Santa (December 19) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
